name: acryl-node-server
description: The standalone HTTP server as a Cordis plugin: one node:http listener that sends every request to the router. Port, loopback host and next-free-port scan; ends open streams and frees the port when unloaded. Vendored from ACRYL.
mount: root.plugin(router); root.plugin(nodeServer, { port: 3000, hostname: '127.0.0.1', scan: 20 }); ctx.nodeServer.url
